chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhassan, from Muawiya ibn Wahb, from Ubayd ibn Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about a man who divorced his wife while he was ill, until he died in that year. He said: She inherits him if it was during the illness in which he divorced her, and he did not recover in between.
ai.seo_question: Does a wife inherit her husband if he divorces her while sick and dies before recovering?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the condition of 'deathbed divorce' (talaq al-marad), establishing that the wife inherits if the husband dies from the same illness during which he divorced her, provided he did not fully recover in between. This ruling highlights the Shia juristic emphasis on the continuity of the specific illness as the causal link for inheritance rights, distinguishing it from general recovery periods. It serves as a foundational text for understanding how marital status and inheritance rights intersect during periods of critical health in Islamic law.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhassan, from Muawiya Bin Wahab, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who divorces his wife and he is sick, until he dies in that year. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She would inherit him when it was during his illness in which he divorced her, while he was not healthy during that (time)’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhsin from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahab from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who divorces his wife during his illness and one year passes. He (the Imam) said, ‘She inherits if it is during his illness in which he divorced her, but not in between (she does not inherit if divorce takes place between two illnesses).”’
